hooks.name: Date and version check reminder
hooks.description: At session start, print current date and remind to always websearch for latest stable versions before hardcoding any version numbers.

action.command:
DATE=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')
echo "📅 Current date: ${DATE}"
echo ""
echo "🔍 REMINDER: Always websearch for latest stable versions before hardcoding:"
echo "   - Terraform, AVM modules, azurerm provider"
echo "   - GitHub Actions (checkout, setup-terraform, azure/login, etc.)"
echo "   - Platform images (ArgoCD, ESO, cert-manager, Kyverno, Velero)"
echo "   - Helm chart versions"
echo "   - AKS supported Kubernetes versions (southeastasia)"
echo ""
echo "   Use: remote_web_search or GitHub API to verify before using any version number."
